name: Prosciutto di Parma PDO (Authentic Aged Italian Ham)
whyItWorks: Regulated PDO product made strictly with two ingredients: Italian pork leg and sea salt, aged for 18+ months. Sliced paper-thin, the delicate cured fat and protein dissolve on the tongue without chewing effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy 1 or 2 thin slices at room temperature paired with ripe cantaloupe melon or gluten-free bread.
